cases, deaths = germany_get_region(landkreis="SK Straubing")

# get population of the region for future normalisation:
inhabitants = population(country="Germany", subregion="SK Straubing")
print(f'Population of country="Germany", subregion="SK Straubing": {inhabitants} people')

# compose into one table
table = compose_dataframe_summary(cases, deaths)

# show tables with up to 1000 rows
pd.set_option("display.max_rows", 1000)

# display the table
table
